_meta.subject: Boeing B-52H Stratofortress
_meta.sheet: 1920x1959, PNG colour-type 4 (grey+alpha); the grey channel is 0 everywhere and the line art lives entirely in alpha, so the sheet MUST be read through the alpha-compositing loader
_meta.rect_origin: top-left: rect=[x,y,w,h] with y counted DOWN from the top row of the image. Convert to a bottom-up (Blender) array as y_bottom = image_height - (y + h).
_meta.rot: degrees COUNTER-CLOCKWISE as the picture is seen, applied to the cropped region BEFORE mirror; np.rot90(crop_top_left_origin, rot/90)
_meta.mirror: horizontal (left-right) flip applied AFTER the rotation
_meta.target_orientation: the orientation render_silhouette() produces: top = nose UP with span horizontal; side = nose LEFT with up = image up (both verified by rendering air_e1_us_bomber)
